title: Personal Checking: extended overdraft fee charged at the wrong amount
content:
## Scope

This rule applies to the bank-error review of the most recently posted extended overdraft fee on a Personal Checking account. It concerns the amount at which the fee was charged, and it is judged whether or not the debit that opened the episode could be identified.

## Formal clause

An extended overdraft fee charged at an amount other than the tier's extended overdraft fee is also a bank error. The amount actually posted for the fee is compared with the extended overdraft fee figure of the checking account's tier.

## Comparison table

| Posted extended overdraft fee compared with the tier's figure | Reading on this ground |
|---|---|
| Equal | No bank error on this ground |
| Above | Bank error |
| Below | Bank error |

## Worked cases (hypothetical tier figures, chosen only for illustration)

- A hypothetical tier's extended overdraft fee is 18.00 USD and the fee posted at 30.00 USD: bank error on this ground.
- The same tier and a fee posted at exactly 18.00 USD: no bank error on this ground.
- A hypothetical tier whose extended overdraft fee figure is 0.00 USD, with an extended overdraft fee posted at 15.00 USD: the posted amount differs from the tier's figure, so the fee is a bank error on this ground.

## Points of judgement

- **Wrong reading:** "the amount ground needs the opening item to be identified first". **Correct basis:** where the opening item is not identified, the amount ground is still judged.
- **Wrong reading:** "only an overcharge is a wrong amount". **Correct basis:** any amount other than the tier's figure is.
